text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen... Naturally, all eyes are on these two, who set last year's respective Classic races ablaze...—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!!
It's Gentildonna and Gold Ship!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Gentil...
So you came."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, sparks are flying!
Are they already throwing down outside the track...?! Photo, photo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, they're both power-type runners...
I wonder which one is stronger?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well then!
Let's dance a song.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I don't mind, though.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Naturally, I'll be taking the lead, correct?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Naive, Gentile.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The dance has already begun.
Ever since the day we met.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Take this!
Shall We Endless!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Practically dragging her along, Gold Ship grabbed
Gentildonna's hand... and suddenly began to dance!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... So elegant...
It almost feels like I can see a ballroom right in front of me...

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
"Still, somehow...
aren't you tensing up a bit?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—...Shall we proceed now?
If you would allow me to take the lead.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: If you want it, try and take it from me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Like this!
—Take thaaaat!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the next moment, Gentildonna
was sent spinning through the air...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Even THAT Gentildonna...!
...Are you saying she was overpowered?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ugh, gross.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Both of them are total monsters.
The younger generation is scary~...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: And what's more, one of them has directly beaten "that person" before, sir.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Being from the same generation as Orfevre, she tends to be overshadowed by her... but she's a powerhouse in her own right.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The younger generation is full of monsters too...
I know that. But still—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: On a stage where "she" isn't present, there's no way I'm letting anyone take the spotlight from me!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —And the title of worthy rival, too.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Verxina-san—
Wait, what's with that look...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...I am...
I, am—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That dance just now was my way of saying hello.
You felt how serious I am, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The giant octopus is mine.
—See you at the live-well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though it was just dance, Gold Ship overpowered her in raw strength.
To think that Gentildonna would...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hold on.
You're wasting precious oxygen thinking.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I know what you're thinking.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
“Still, there is no need for anything new.
I have an idea.”

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I've gotten a pretty good grasp
of her power.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If that is so...
then all that remains is to surpass it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Right.
Just like before."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Would you care for a dance?
Just you and me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"If you do that,
you'll understand too, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Led by Gentildonna, I dance without fully
understanding what's happening.
Before long, I suddenly realize...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I expected a powerful dance like Gold Ship's,
but... Gentildonna is remarkably delicate.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Without breaking even a fragile opponent like you,
I will control it all flawlessly.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Just like how you adjust your grip depending on the occasion.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Wielding overflowing power with delicate control...
That is true strength.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-san's strength,
and my strength—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Let us clash and see
which of us possesses greater might.
